value.description: An anchor of Ashes and twisted iron where Annelitrice Undead can craft transmog apparel, items made from Ashes, and Annelitrice Souls.

The lingering essence drawn from living things. To most, consuming a Soul is a deeply unnatural act, bringing nausea, fevered visions, and violent shocks to the mind. Annelitrice Undead can take Souls into themselves without harm, as living creatures digest food.

A small Painted World of towers and snow-covered forests. Those within know they are watched by beings beyond the frame, yet fear has taught them silence. They live out their little lives beneath that gaze, pretending not to notice the eyes above.
